what: Several full-bleed work photo Sections are stacked, and every 5s (immediately when a dot is clicked) the next Section is revealed from the right by clip-path in 1.2s while its photo moves into place from 20% to the right (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). In the outgoing Section the client name letters scatter ±21vw per cell and the photo shifts -25%, the incoming Section’s letters start scattered the opposite way and gather into place in .8s after .45s. The one-line text rises from 25% below, one by one from the end at .1s intervals

options.every: Auto-advance interval (seconds), default 5 — 0 means only on press
options.ease: Curve (bezier values or GSAP name), default 0.19,1,0.22,1
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sections (children) to flip — put is-active on the one shown first
options.[data-fx-part=char]: Each letter of the customer name inside the section
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Section number dots (optional) — paired with sections in order, the current one gets is-active
options.[data-fx-part=count]: Current section number text (optional) — shown in 01 type

use:
A…
…
note: Sections are stacked with position:absolute and sections without is-active get display:none — the part turns them on only when switching. Letters move with the CSS variable --x, so no separate transform is applied to the letters

from.where: index.html .bp-bleed (full-bleed work slide) — original BleedSlider: clipPath inset(0 0 0 100%)→0 1.2 slow-out, photo xPercent 20→0, outgoing text --x ±21vw · photo -25%, incoming text --x 0 .8s(<+.45), info yPercent 25 each .1 from end
